description: ClickUp structure for the Vios department (docs/operating-system.md). Recreate in any workspace by asking Claude to 'recreate the ClickUp structure from setup/clickup.json'. Ids below are the personal-account instance.

folder.name: Vios Marketing

lists.name: Department — Setup & SOP
lists.content: Department build tasks, onboarding checklists, quarterly reviews.

lists.name: <Client> — Deliverables
lists.content: One task per Vios deliverable (Stages 1–4, briefs, proposal, harvest). Stage + Approver fields on every task.

lists.name: <Client> — Open facts
lists.content: Mirror of clients/<slug>/open-facts.md, one task per open row; scripts/clients.py facts <slug> builds the payload.

lists.name: <Client> — Content
lists.content: One task per post. Draft → Review → Approved (qa-log signed) → Scheduled (Metricool) → Published → Done.

lists.name: <Client> — Engagement
lists.content: Daily triage batches (comments, DMs, reviews). Hard-line 11 escalations carry the facts only.

lists.name: <Client> — Ads
lists.content: Weekly vios-ads-audit action list. Pauses and budget changes need the client owner.

folder.per_client: Create the five <Client> lists for every onboarded client.

personal_2026-10-29.updated: 2026-11-02: statuses renamed QA→Review, Reported→Done; Stage + Approver folder fields; Deliverables + Open facts lists per client; 2026-11-02: ONE Gallery five lists

per_client_rule: Each client's accounts.md lists its three ClickUp list ids; scheduled tasks read them from there.

status_use.engagement deliverables: Draft → Review → Approved (= signed) → Done (= delivered as PDF)
status_use.marketing posts: Draft → Review → Approved (qa-log signed) → Scheduled → Published → Done (reported)
